artworks.label: Pond water strider
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for lotus-drift. A graceful natural water strider balanced on one small lens-shaped pool of deep twilight-blue water, delicate bronze-brown body and six long fine legs making distinct little circular dimples, one tiny fallen blush-pink lotus petal at the pool edge. Photoreal botanical pond macro study, soft evening light with rose-gold reflections, dark blue/sage/blush/bronze palette. Water patch has an organic outline, not a square; no lotus blossom, dragonfly, frog, minnow or tea bowl. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
